Software architecture · 6 levels

Intellica Architecture Academy

A six-level professional pathway in software architecture—from foundations and documentation through quality analysis, agentic systems, governance and enterprise leadership. Available courses develop practical judgement through worked examples, architecture artefacts and structured self-review; planned levels are identified separately. 3 of the 6 levels currently have published courses available. The remaining levels are in development and are shown with their intended outcomes and scope.

How the academy works

Applied architecture work

Each available course develops a practical architecture artefact through guided tasks, worked examples and structured self-review. The course page explains the scope and limits of its health checks.

Preview before enrolment

Each available course includes free preview lessons so you can inspect the teaching approach and course materials before enrolling.

Clear progression requirements

Each level page publishes its intended outcomes, prerequisites, available learning materials and current delivery status.

Programme scope and credential status

  • Level 1 is independent Intellica self-study aligned to the published iSAQB CPSA-F curriculum version 2025.1. It is not an iSAQB course, and Intellica is not an iSAQB-accredited training provider. The iSAQB examination is separate and is administered under the rules of an authorised certification body. The current public CPSA-F curriculum is 2025.1; a 2027.1 release candidate is published for an effective date of 1 April 2027, and Intellica will version its mapping before that date.
  • The mock examinations use original Intellica practice questions derived from public curriculum topics. They are not official iSAQB examination questions and cannot guarantee a pass.
  • The current course certificates record completion under their published course rules. They are not iSAQB credentials. Intellica’s independently assessed higher-level credentials remain in development.
  • Levels marked Planned do not yet have an available course. Their pages identify the intended scope; contact Intellica for release information.
